steps.text: Bring a rope, a shovel, a power ring, a barrel and 3 parcels (or exani hur).
steps.source: Rope, Shovel, 1-2 Power Rings, Barrel, 3 Parcels (or Levitate if you have it)

steps.text: Key 3301 is in the dead tree next to the minotaur tower (a dead body next to it). Mind the pitfall next to it.
steps.source: Copper Key 3301: In a dead tree right next to the minotaur tower. There is a dead body next to the tree.

steps.text: Key 3302 is in the dead tree just north of the minotaur tower.
steps.source: Silver Key 3302: Just north of the minotaur tower, in a dead tree.

steps.text: Key 3303 is in the dead tree at the campsite south of the main buildings.
steps.source: Copper Key 3303: In a campsite south of the main buildings of the Outlaw Camp, in a dead tree.

steps.text: Dig open the hole behind the trees: the wild warrior cave.
steps.source: Now, take these keys, and go into the Wild Warrior cave. The shovel hole is hidden behind a tree.

steps.text: Follow the path north (wild warriors) to the room with four ladders down; take the one in the north-west corner.
steps.source: At the end of this path is a larger room with four ladders going down. Take the ladder in the north-west corner.

steps.text: Open the door with key 3303.
steps.source: Here you will see a locked door with a switch behind it. Unlock the door with Key 3303, and flip the switch.

steps.text: Flip the switch: it moves the oven in the room south of you.
steps.source: This switch moves an oven in the room directly south of you.

steps.text: Go back up and down the ladder to the south.
steps.source: Go back up the ladder, and then down the ladder to your south.

steps.text: Behind the oven: key 3304.
steps.source: There will be an oven with a Chest (Quest) behind it. If the switch is in the correct position, you can fit behind the oven and open the chest to get Key 3304.

steps.text: Bring the barrel to the shovel hole near the water north of the camp and go down.
steps.source: Drag a barrel back to the Outlaw Camp, and down a shovel hole near the water to the north.

steps.text: Follow the only way to its end and go down.
steps.source: There is only one way you can go in this cave. Follow it all the way to the end, where you can go no further.

steps.text: In this very small room, put the barrel in the north-west corner. You rope it up through a hole later.
steps.source: In this very small room, place the barrel in the north-west corner. You will rope it up through a hole later on.

steps.text: Go up the minotaur tower, two floors.
steps.source: Once the barrel is in place, go back to the minotaur tower to the south, and go up two levels.

steps.text: Past the "Point of No Return" sign, walk off the roof: you fall all the way underground.
steps.source: There will be a sign that says "Point of No Return". This leads to the Giant Spiders. Simply walk off of the roof and you will fall all the way underground.

steps.text: Follow the passage west and north (a giant spider). At the north end, go down the ledge with exani hur or 3 parcels (orc spearmen and an orc berserker below).
steps.source: At the north end of this cave, there will be a ledge. You'll need Levitate or three parcels. The typical spawn down the ledge consists of Orc Spearman and Orc Berserkers.

steps.text: Take the left of the two passages north. Put the power ring on the counter, then flip the switch: the ring is teleported away.
steps.source: There will be two passages to the north. Go up the passage on the left. Here you will find a wooden surface and a switch. Place the Power Ring on the wooden surface, and then flip the switch.

steps.text: Take the right passage north (an orc shaman, an orc warrior) and go up the ladder.
steps.source: Now, take the right passage to the north. You will see a ladder going up, and a ladder going down. Take the ladder UP.

steps.text: Follow the short passage to the open hole: do not fall down! Use your rope on it to pull up your barrel.
steps.source: Follow this short passage, and you will see an open hole. DO NOT FALL DOWN THIS HOLE! "Use" a rope on the hole to rope-up your barrel.

steps.text: Take the barrel back down and to the left, and throw it down the ladder.
steps.source: Now, drag the barrel back down the hole (towards the Orcs) and to the left, throw the barrel down the ladder.

steps.text: Kill the skeletons, the ghoul and the beholder first: they can push and break the barrel.
steps.source: there will be some Skeletons, Ghouls and two Bonelords to the south in this room) kill them first cause ghouls and skeletons from Bonelords can push and break the barrel.

steps.text: Drag the barrel east through the level 45 door, down the passage to the wall. Put it in the gap at the south part of the wall: it stops the wall when you flip the next switch.
steps.source: Drag the barrel to the east, and through the level 45 Gate of Expertise. Continue down this passage until you come to a wall blocking your path. On the south part of this wall, there will be a small portion of the wall that the barrel will fit into. Place the barrel here.

steps.text: Back at the minotaur tower, fall down the pitfall next to the dead tree.
steps.source: Now go back to the Minotaur camp. Instead of going up, fall down the hole next to the dead tree. This is a pitfall.

steps.text: Follow the passage north: open the first door with key 3301.
steps.source: Follow the passage to the north. You will need to go through two locked doors. The first one needs Key 3301, and the second one needs Key 3302.

steps.text: Open the second door with key 3302.
steps.source: The first one needs Key 3301, and the second one needs Key 3302.

steps.text: At the ladder up and the ladder down, go down, and down again.
steps.source: You will eventually come to a ladder going up, and a ladder going down. Go down.

steps.text: In the room with the mill, flip the switch: your power ring turns into a fire field.
steps.source: Continue until you see a room with Fire Fields on the floor. This room also has a Mill with a switch. Flip the switch. The Power Ring will turn into a fire field.

steps.text: Go back to the barrel in the wall (past the level 45 door; someone can rope you up the hole, or go through the giant spiders again). There is now a way through the wall.
steps.source: Now go back to where you placed the barrel in the wall (past the level 45 Gate of Expertise). If done correctly, there will be a passage through the wall.

steps.text: Demon skeletons and skeletons.
steps.source: Here you will face 3 Demon Skeletons and 2 Skeletons.

steps.text: Open the door with key 3304.
steps.source: After killing the Demon Skeletons, use Golden Key 3304 to unlock the door.

steps.text: The chest: a bag with the bright sword and a red gem.
steps.source: Open the Chest (Quest) to receive your Bright Sword and Red Gem inside a bag.
